sentences.text: South Australia’s Independent Commission Against Corruption investigated allegations that public funds paid for selected internal applicants to obtain recruitment assistance.
sentences.support: The Commission investigated allegations that a Chief Executive of a public authority paid a recruitment company

sentences.text: The Commission established that a chief executive approved assistance for four internal applicants, while a fifth applicant received no equivalent funding.
sentences.support: The investigation established that a Chief Executive approved the use of public funds to assist four internal candidates

sentences.text: The Commission found no corruption because there was no intention to favour candidates unfairly, but considered that the process could reasonably appear to give some an unfair advantage.
sentences.support: The Commission determined that there was no intention to unfairly favour any candidate and therefore that there was no corruption.

sentences.text: Its recommended safeguards covered conflict declarations, disclosure of prior development assistance, equal access to support, independent panel members and alternative referees.
sentences.support: Clearly setting out that internal candidates must not receive, at the public agency’s expense, coaching, advice or information

findings.quote: The Commission determined that there was no intention to unfairly favour any candidate and therefore that there was no corruption.
While it may not have been the Chief Executive’s intention to unfairly advantage some applicants, it would be a reasonable perception that such an advantage was afforded to some applicants.

notes: No separate executive summary or overview. Recommendations comprise five lettered safeguards under a single introductory recommendation, so no overall numbered recommendation count is asserted.
